PRODUCT OVERVIEW

About the Deepal Laser Transmitter

The Deepal Laser Transmitter establishes the consistent laser plane followed by the receiver during grading. The protected central rotary head, wide carrying frame and clearly grouped keypad support convenient field handling and setup.

Key features

  • Rotating laser reference plane
  • Protected central rotary head
  • Integrated carrying frame
  • Clearly grouped control keypad
  • Tripod-ready field placement
  • Supports compatible receiver systems

Applications

  • Agricultural field levelling
  • Grade-reference establishment
  • Field preparation for irrigation
  • Receiver-assisted equipment control
